en.title: Democrats Win Control of Congress as Trump Faces Cabinet and Diplomatic Fallout
en.dek: Democrats cleared 250 House seats and won control of both chambers, while Trump addressed Russia, Iran, and tech stocks.
facts: Democrats cleared 250 House seats and won control of both chambers of Congress, according to The New York Times and DW.
The Nasdaq fell 5.5% on November 5 as investors reacted to possible tighter AI scrutiny, according to Nikkei Asia.
Trump met Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev in Washington and said a Russia-Ukraine deal is near, according to Al Jazeera.
Trump told reporters he would rather not destroy the rest of Iran but maybe he will have to, according to The Jerusalem Post.
Vice President J.D. Vance criticized the Trump administration after the midterm defeat, according to SRF.
The White House denied that Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth plan to leave, according to BBC.
body: Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections. The New York Times reported that Democrats cleared 250 House seats. The Straits Times and DW reported that the party won control of both chambers.

President Donald Trump met Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev in Washington. Trump said a "big, beautiful agreement" was coming, according to The Kyiv Independent. Al Jazeera reported that Trump said a Russia-Ukraine deal is near after the meeting.

Trump told reporters in the Oval Office that he would rather not destroy the rest of Iran but maybe he will have to, according to The Jerusalem Post. Euronews reported that US officials warned Gulf allies to prepare for possible new strikes.
Vice President J.D. Vance posted online after the Republican midterm defeat and criticized the Trump administration, according to SRF. ZDF reported that Vance sought distance from the government.

The Nasdaq fell 5.5% on November 5, according to Nikkei Asia. BBC reported that global tech stocks plunged as investors reacted to possible tighter scrutiny of the AI industry and data center construction.

The White House denied that Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth plan to leave their jobs after Republican election losses, according to BBC. Rubio also denied plans to leave his post for a White House bid, The Japan Times reported.
The 2026 U.S. midterm elections produced Republican losses and a shift in congressional control. DW reported that the GOP was reeling after losing both houses of Congress.
en.context: The 2026 U.S. midterm elections produced Republican losses and a shift in congressional control. DW reported that the GOP was reeling after losing both houses of Congress.

en.title: 2026 US Midterm Elections
en.dek: Democrats make major gains in the House, Senate and state legislatures in the 2026 midterms, with several races still being called.

fr.title: Élections de mi-mandat de 2026 aux États-Unis
fr.dek: Les démocrates réalisent d’importants gains à la Chambre des représentants, au Sénat et dans les législatures des États lors des élections de mi-mandat de 2026, plusieurs scrutins n’étant pas encore tranchés.

de.title: Zwischenwahlen in den USA 2026
de.dek: Demokraten erzielen deutliche Zugewinne im Repräsentantenhaus, im Senat und in den Landesparlamenten bei den Zwischenwahlen 2026, während das Ergebnis in mehreren Wahlkreisen noch nicht feststeht.

zh.title: 2026年美国中期选举
zh.dek: 民主党在2026年中期选举中于众议院、参议院及各州议会取得重大进展，部分选区的结果仍在计票中。

it.title: Elezioni di metà mandato statunitensi del 2026
it.dek: I democratici ottengono importanti avanzate alla Camera, al Senato e nelle legislature statali nelle elezioni di metà mandato del 2026, con diverse gare ancora da assegnare.

pt.title: Eleições de meio de mandato nos EUA em 2026
pt.dek: Os democratas obtêm ganhos importantes na Câmara dos Representantes, no Senado e nas legislaturas estaduais nas eleições de meio de mandato de 2026, com várias disputas ainda por decidir.

ja.title: 2026年米中間選挙
ja.dek: 2026年の中間選挙で、民主党は下院、上院、州議会で大きな成果を上げた。一部の選挙区では現在も当選者の確定が続いている。

ko.title: 2026년 미국 중간선거
ko.dek: 민주당이 2026년 중간선거에서 하원과 상원, 주 의회에서 큰 이득을 얻었다. 일부 선거구는 아직 당선이 확정되지 않았다.

es.title: Elecciones de mitad de mandato de 2026 en EE. UU.
es.dek: Los demócratas logran importantes avances en la Cámara de Representantes, el Senado y las legislaturas estatales en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de 2026, con varias contiendas aún sin definir.

en.headline: Trump says new Iran strikes possible after meeting security advisers
en.body: After meeting national security advisers, Trump told reporters in the Oval Office that he would rather not destroy the rest of Iran but maybe he will have to, according to The Jerusalem Post. Euronews reported that US officials warned Gulf allies to prepare for possible new strikes.

it.headline: Trump: possibili nuovi attacchi all'Iran dopo l'incontro con i consiglieri di sicurezza
it.body: Dopo aver incontrato i consiglieri per la sicurezza nazionale, Trump ha detto ai giornalisti nello Studio Ovale che preferirebbe non distruggere il resto dell'Iran, ma forse dovrà farlo, secondo The Jerusalem Post. Euronews ha riportato che funzionari degli Stati Uniti hanno avvertito gli alleati del Golfo di prepararsi a possibili nuovi attacchi.

de.headline: Trump: Nach Treffen mit Sicherheitsberatern sind neue Angriffe auf Iran möglich
de.body: Nach einem Treffen mit nationalen Sicherheitsberatern sagte Trump Reportern im Oval Office, er wolle den übrigen Teil Irans lieber nicht zerstören, müsse es aber vielleicht, berichtet The Jerusalem Post. Euronews meldete, US-Beamte hätten Verbündete am Golf gewarnt, sich auf mögliche neue Angriffe vorzubereiten.

es.headline: Trump afirma que podría realizar nuevos ataques contra Irán tras reunirse con sus asesores de seguridad
es.body: Tras reunirse con sus asesores de seguridad nacional, Trump dijo a los periodistas en el Despacho Oval que preferiría no destruir el resto de Irán, pero quizá tenga que hacerlo, según The Jerusalem Post. Euronews informó de que funcionarios estadounidenses advirtieron a los aliados del Golfo de que se preparen para posibles nuevos ataques.

fr.headline: Trump dit que de nouvelles frappes contre l’Iran sont possibles après une réunion avec ses conseillers à la sécurité
fr.body: Après avoir rencontré ses conseillers à la sécurité nationale, Trump a déclaré aux journalistes dans le Bureau ovale qu’il préférerait ne pas détruire le reste de l’Iran, mais qu’il devrait peut-être le faire, selon le Jerusalem Post. Euronews a rapporté que des responsables américains ont mis en garde les alliés du Golfe afin qu’ils se préparent à d’éventuelles nouvelles frappes.

zh.headline: 特朗普会见安全顾问后称可能对伊朗发动新一轮打击
zh.body: 据《耶路撒冷邮报》报道，特朗普在椭圆形办公室会见国家安全顾问后对记者表示，他宁愿不摧毁伊朗的其余部分，但也许他将不得不这么做。欧洲新闻台报道称，美国官员警告海湾盟友为可能的新打击做好准备。

pt.headline: Trump diz que novos ataques ao Irão são possíveis após reunião com conselheiros de segurança
pt.body: Depois de se reunir com conselheiros de segurança nacional, Trump disse a jornalistas no Gabinete Oval que preferiria não destruir o resto do Irão, mas talvez tenha de o fazer, segundo o The Jerusalem Post. A Euronews noticiou que responsáveis norte-americanos alertaram aliados do Golfo para se prepararem para possíveis novos ataques.

ja.headline: トランプ氏、イランへの新たな攻撃の可能性に言及 安保補佐官らと会合で
ja.body: エルサレム・ポストによると、トランプ大統領は国家安全保障担当補佐官らとの会合後、オーバルオフィスで記者団に対し、イランの残りを破壊したくはないが、そうしなければならないかもしれないと述べた。ユーロニュースは、米当局者が湾岸の同盟国に新たな攻撃の可能性に備えるよう警告したと報じた。

ko.headline: 국가안보 고문 회담 후 트럼프, 이란 추가 공격 가능성 언급
ko.body: 예루살렘 포스트에 따르면 트럼프는 국가안보 고문들을 만난 뒤 오벌 오피스에서 기자들에게 이란의 나머지 지역을 파괴하고 싶지는 않지만 어쩌면 결국 해야 할 수도 있다고 말했다. 유로뉴스는 미국 당국이 걸프 동맹들에게 새로운 공격에 대비할 준비를 하라고 경고했다고 보도했다.

sources.title: 'You'll know soon enough': Trump leaves door open to devastating new Iran strikes
Europe Today: Trump weighs Iran strikes as Ukraine talks head to Abu Dhabi

en.headline: Trump says Russia-Ukraine deal is near after meeting Putin envoy
en.body: Trump met Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev in Washington and said a 'big, beautiful agreement' was coming, according to The Kyiv Independent. Al Jazeera reported that Trump said a Russia-Ukraine deal is near after the meeting.

it.headline: Trump: un accordo Russia-Ucraina è vicino dopo l'incontro con l'inviato di Putin
it.body: Trump ha incontrato a Washington l'inviato russo Kirill Dmitriev e ha detto che era in arrivo un 'grande, bellissimo accordo', secondo The Kyiv Independent. Al Jazeera ha riportato che Trump ha detto che un accordo tra Russia e Ucraina è vicino dopo l'incontro.

de.headline: Trump: Russland-Ukraine-Abkommen steht nach Treffen mit Putin-Botschafter bevor
de.body: Trump traf den russischen Botschafter Kirill Dmitriew in Washington und sagte laut The Kyiv Independent, ein „großes, wunderschönes Abkommen“ sei in Aussicht. Al Jazeera berichtete, Trump habe nach dem Treffen gesagt, ein Russland-Ukraine-Abkommen stehe bevor.

es.headline: Trump afirma que un acuerdo entre Rusia y Ucrania está cerca tras reunirse con el enviado de Putin
es.body: Trump se reunió con el enviado ruso Kirill Dmitriev en Washington y dijo que estaba en camino un «gran y hermoso acuerdo», según The Kyiv Independent. Al Jazeera informó de que Trump dijo que un acuerdo entre Rusia y Ucrania está cerca tras la reunión.

fr.headline: Trump dit qu’un accord russo-ukrainien est proche après avoir rencontré un émissaire de Poutine
fr.body: Trump a rencontré à Washington l’émissaire russe Kirill Dmitriev et a déclaré qu’un « grand et bel accord » était en vue, selon le Kyiv Independent. Al Jazeera a rapporté que Trump avait déclaré, après la rencontre, qu’un accord russo-ukrainien était proche.

zh.headline: 特朗普会见普京特使后称俄乌协议接近达成
zh.body: 据《基辅独立报》报道，特朗普在华盛顿会见了俄罗斯特使基里尔·德米特里耶夫，并表示一项“宏大而美好的协议”即将达成。半岛电视台报道称，特朗普在会后表示俄乌协议已接近达成。

pt.headline: Trump diz que acordo Rússia-Ucrânia está perto após reunião com enviado de Putin
pt.body: Trump reuniu-se com o enviado russo Kirill Dmitriev em Washington e disse que um 'grande e belo acordo' estava a caminho, segundo o The Kyiv Independent. A Al Jazeera noticiou que Trump disse que um acordo Rússia-Ucrânia está perto após a reunião.

ja.headline: プーチン特使との会談後、トランプ大統領「ロシア・ウクライナ合意は近い」
ja.body: キーウ独立新聞によると、トランプ大統領はワシントンでロシア特使キrill・ドミトrievと会談し、「大きく美しい合意」が近づいていると述べた。アルジャazeeraは、会談後にトランプがロシア・ウクライナ合意は近いと述べた다고報じた。

ko.headline: 푸틴 특사 만난 뒤 트럼프, 러시아-우크라이나 합의 임박 가능성 언급
ko.body: 키이프 인디펜던트에 따르면 트럼프는 워싱턴에서 러시아 특사 키릴 드미트리예프를 만나 곧 ‘거대한, 아름다운 합의’가 이뤄질 것이라고 말했다. 알자지라는 트럼프가 회담 이후 러시아-우크라이나 합의가 임박했다고 말했다고 보도했다.

Trump meets Russian envoy in Washington ahead of Ukraine peace talks, claims 'big, beautiful agreement' coming

en.headline: Vance distances himself from Trump administration after midterm losses
en.body: Vice President J.D. Vance posted online after the Republican midterm defeat and criticized the Trump administration, according to SRF. ZDF reported that Vance sought distance from the government.

it.headline: Vance si distacca dall'amministrazione Trump dopo la sconfitta alle elezioni di metà mandato
it.body: Il vice presidente J.D. Vance ha pubblicato un messaggio online dopo la sconfitta dei repubblicani alle elezioni di metà mandato e ha criticato l'amministrazione Trump, secondo SRF. ZDF ha riportato che Vance ha cercato di prendere le distanze dal governo.

de.headline: Vance distanziert sich nach Niederlage bei Zwischenwahlen von Trump-Regierung
de.body: US-Vizepräsident J.D. Vance veröffentlichte nach der Niederlage der Republikaner bei den Zwischenwahlen einen Beitrag online und kritisierte die Trump-Regierung, berichtet SRF. ZDF berichtete, Vance habe Abstand von der Regierung gesucht.

es.headline: Vance se distancia de la administración Trump tras las pérdidas en las elecciones de mitad de mandato
es.body: El vicepresidente J.D. Vance publicó en internet tras la derrota republicana en las elecciones de mitad de mandato y criticó a la administración Trump, según SRF. ZDF informó de que Vance buscó distancia respecto del gobierno.

fr.headline: Vance prend ses distances avec l’administration Trump après les défaites aux élections de mi-mandat
fr.body: Selon SRF, le vice-président J.D. Vance a publié un message en ligne après la défaite des républicains aux élections de mi-mandat et a critiqué l’administration Trump. ZDF a rapporté que Vance avait cherché à prendre ses distances avec le gouvernement.

zh.headline: 万斯在中期选举失利后与特朗普政府保持距离
zh.body: 据瑞士广播电视（SRF）报道，副总统J.D.万斯在共和党中期选举失利后发帖批评特朗普政府。德国电视二台（ZDF）报道称，万斯试图与政府保持距离。

pt.headline: Vance distancia-se da administração Trump após derrotas nas eleições de meio de mandato
pt.body: O vice-presidente J.D. Vance publicou online após a derrota republicana nas eleições de meio de mandato e criticou a administração Trump, segundo a SRF. A ZDF noticiou que Vance procurou distanciar-se do governo.

ja.headline: 中間選挙の敗北後、バンスがトランプ政権から距離置く
ja.body: SRFによると、共和党の中間選挙敗北後、副大統領J.D.バンスはインターネット上に投稿し、トランプ政権を批判した。ZDFは、バンスが政府から距離を取ろうとしたと報じた。

ko.headline: 중간선거 패배 뒤 밴스, 트럼프 행정부와 거리두기
ko.body: SRF에 따르면 공직 J.D. 밴스는 공화당 중간선거 패배 후 온라인에 글을 올리며 트럼프 행정부를 비판했다. ZDF는 밴스가 정부와 거리를 두려 했다고 보도했다.

sources.title: Nach Midterms-Debakel – Vizepräsident J.D. Vance übt scharfe Kritik an Trump-Regierung
Jetzt sucht Trumps Vize die Distanz

de.body: Laut The New York Times gewannen die Demokraten bei den US-Zwischenwahlen 2026 250 Sitze im Repräsentantenhaus. The Straits Times und DW berichteten, dass die Partei die Kontrolle über beide Kammern des Kongresses gewonnen hat.
de.headline: Demokraten gewinnen die Kontrolle über beide Kammern des Kongresses

en.body: According to The New York Times, Democrats cleared 250 House seats in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections. The Straits Times and DW reported that the party won control of both chambers of Congress.
en.headline: Democrats win control of both chambers of Congress

es.body: Según The New York Times, los demócratas conquistaron 250 escaños en la Cámara de Representantes en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de 2026 en Estados Unidos. The Straits Times y DW informaron de que el partido ganó el control de ambas cámaras del Congreso.
es.headline: Los demócratas conquistan el control de ambas cámaras del Congreso

fr.body: Selon The New York Times, les démocrates ont remporté 250 sièges à la Chambre des représentants lors des élections de mi-mandat de 2026 aux États-Unis. The Straits Times et DW ont rapporté que le parti a pris le contrôle des deux chambres du Congrès.
fr.headline: Les démocrates prennent le contrôle des deux chambres du Congrès

it.body: Secondo The New York Times, i Democratici hanno conquistato 250 seggi alla Camera nelle elezioni di metà mandato negli Stati Uniti del 2026. The Straits Times e DW hanno riportato che il partito ha vinto il controllo di entrambe le camere del Congresso.
it.headline: I Democratici conquistano il controllo di entrambe le camere del Congresso

zh.headline: 民主党赢得国会两院控制权
zh.body: 据《纽约时报》报道，民主党在2026年美国中期选举中赢得了250个众议院席位。《海峡时报》和德国之声报道称，该党赢得了国会两院的控制权。

pt.headline: Democratas conquistam controlo de ambas as câmaras do Congresso
pt.body: Segundo o The New York Times, os democratas ultrapassaram 250 lugares na Câmara dos Representantes nas eleições de meio de mandato norte-americanas de 2026. O The Straits Times e a DW noticiaram que o partido conquistou o controlo de ambas as câmaras do Congresso.

ja.headline: 民主党、米国会上下両院を掌握
ja.body: ニューヨーク・タイムズによると、民主党は2026年の米国中間選挙で下院250議席を確保した。ストレーツ・タイムズとDWは、民主党が米国会上下両院を掌握したと報じた。

ko.headline: 민주당, 의회 양원 장악
ko.body: 뉴욕타임스에 따르면 민주당은 2026년 미국 중간선거에서 하원 의석 250석을 확보했다. 스트레이트타임스와 DW는 민주당이 의회 양원 모두의 통제권을 장악했다고 보도했다.

US pro-Trump election deniers crash against ‘blue tsunami’
GOP reeling after losing both houses of Congress in US midterms

de.body: Der Nasdaq fiel am 5. November um 5,5 Prozent, wie Nikkei Asia berichtete. Die BBC berichtete, dass weltweite Tech-Aktien einbrachen, als Anleger auf eine möglicherweise strengere Kontrolle der KI-Branche und des Rechenzentrumsbaus reagierten.
de.headline: Tech-Aktien fallen, da Zwischenwahlen Sorgen vor KI-Regulierung schüren

en.body: The Nasdaq fell 5.5% on November 5, according to Nikkei Asia. BBC reported that global tech stocks plunged as investors reacted to possible tighter scrutiny of the AI industry and data center construction.
en.headline: Tech stocks fall as midterms fuel AI regulation fears

es.body: El Nasdaq cayó un 5,5 % el 5 de noviembre, según Nikkei Asia. BBC informó de que las acciones tecnológicas de todo el mundo se desplomaron mientras los inversores reaccionaban a la posibilidad de un escrutinio más estricto de la industria de la IA y de la construcción de centros de datos.
es.headline: Las acciones tecnológicas caen mientras las elecciones de mitad de mandato alimentan el temor a la regulación de la IA

fr.body: Le Nasdaq a reculé de 5,5 % le 5 novembre, selon Nikkei Asia. La BBC a rapporté que les valeurs technologiques mondiales se sont effondrées, les investisseurs réagissant à la possibilité d’un contrôle plus strict de l’industrie de l’IA et de la construction de centres de données.
fr.headline: Les valeurs technologiques reculent, les élections de mi-mandat alimentant les craintes liées à la réglementation de l’IA

it.body: Il Nasdaq è sceso del 5,5% il 5 novembre, secondo Nikkei Asia. La BBC ha riportato che i titoli tech di tutto il mondo sono precipitati mentre gli investitori reagivano alla possibilità di un controllo più rigoroso sull'industria dell'IA e sulla costruzione dei data center.
it.headline: I titoli tech crollano mentre le elezioni di metà mandato alimentano i timori sulla regolamentazione dell'IA

zh.headline: 中期选举加剧AI监管担忧，科技股下跌
zh.body: 据《日经亚洲》报道，纳斯达克指数11月5日下跌5.5%。BBC报道称，由于投资者对人工智能行业和数据中心建设可能面临更严格审查作出反应，全球科技股暴跌。

pt.headline: Ações de tecnologia caem enquanto eleições de meio de mandato alimentam receios de regulação da IA
pt.body: A Nasdaq caiu 5,5% em 5 de novembro, segundo a Nikkei Asia. A BBC noticiou que as ações globais de tecnologia despencaram enquanto os investidores reagiam a um possível escrutínio mais apertado da indústria de IA e da construção de centros de dados.

ja.headline: 中間選挙を機にAI規制への懸念強まる、テクノロジー株下落
ja.body: 日経アジアによると、ナスダックは11月5日に5.5%下落した。BBCは、投資家がAI産業やデータセンター建設に対するより厳格な監視の可能性に反応し、世界のテクノロジー株が急落したと報じた。

ko.headline: 중간선거 이후 AI 규제 우려 커지며 기술주 하락
ko.body: 닛케이 아시아에 따르면 나스닥지수는 11월 5일 5.5% 하락했다. BBC는 투자자들이 AI 산업과 데이터센터 건설에 대한 보다 엄격한 감시의 가능성에 반응하면서 세계 기술주가 급락했다고 보도했다.

sources.title: US midterms live: Nasdaq plunges 5.5% on AI regulation fears
Global tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to AI slowdown fears

de.body: Das Weiße Haus bestreitete laut BBC, dass Außenminister Marco Rubio und Verteidigungsminister Pete Hegseth vorhaben, ihre Ämter nach den Wahlniederlagen der Republikaner zu verlassen. Rubio bestreitete zudem, seinen Posten im Zuge einer Kandidatur für das Weiße Haus aufgeben zu wollen, wie The Japan Times berichtete.
de.headline: Rubio und Hegseth bestreiten Pläne, die Trump-Administration zu verlassen

en.body: The White House denied that Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth plan to leave their jobs after Republican election losses, according to BBC. Rubio also denied plans to leave his post for a White House bid, The Japan Times reported.
en.headline: Rubio and Hegseth deny plans to leave Trump administration

es.body: La Casa Blanca desmintió que el secretario de Estado, Marco Rubio, y el secretario de Defensa, Pete Hegseth, planean abandonar sus cargos tras las pérdidas electorales republicanas, según BBC. Rubio también desmintió que tuviera planes de dejar su puesto para presentarse a la Casa Blanca, informó The Japan Times.
es.headline: Rubio y Hegseth desmienten planes para abandonar la administración Trump

fr.body: La Maison-Blanche a démenti les projets du secrétaire d’État Marco Rubio et du secrétaire à la Défense Pete Hegseth de quitter leurs fonctions après les défaites électorales des républicains, selon la BBC. Rubio a également nié toute intention de quitter ses fonctions pour se présenter à la Maison-Blanche, a rapporté The Japan Times.
fr.headline: Rubio et Hegseth nient toute intention de quitter l’administration Trump

it.body: La Casa Bianca ha smentito che il segretario di Stato Marco Rubio e il segretario alla Difesa Pete Hegseth intendano lasciare i loro incarichi dopo le sconfitte elettorali dei repubblicani, secondo la BBC. Rubio ha inoltre smentito i piani di lasciare il suo posto per una candidatura alla Casa Bianca, ha riportato The Japan Times.
it.headline: Rubio e Hegseth smentiscono i piani di lasciare l'amministrazione Trump

zh.headline: 鲁比奥和赫格塞斯否认计划离开特朗普政府
zh.body: 据BBC报道，白宫否认国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥和国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯计划在共和党选举失利后离职。《日本时报》报道称，鲁比奥还否认了为竞选白宫而离职的计划。

pt.headline: Rubio e Hegseth negam planos de sair da administração de Trump
pt.body: A Casa Branca desmentiu que o secretário de Estado Marco Rubio e o secretário da Defesa Pete Hegseth tencionam deixar os seus cargos após as derrotas eleitorais dos republicanos, de acordo com a BBC. Rubio também desmentiu planos de deixar o cargo para uma candidatura à Casa Branca, informou o Japan Times.

ja.headline: ルビオとヘグセス、トランプ政権離脱の意向否定
ja.body: BBCによると、共和党が選挙で敗北した後、白宮は国務長官マルコ・ルビオと国防長官ピート・ヘグセスが職務を離れる計画はないと否定した。ジャパン・タイムズによると、ルビオは白宮入りを目指すために現職を離れる計画はないとも否定した。

ko.headline: 루비오와 헤그세스, 트럼프 행정부 탈퇴 계획 부인
ko.body: BBC에 따르면 백악관은 공화당 선거 패배 뒤 마르코 루비오 국무장관과 피트 헤그세스 국방장관이 직책을 떠나려는 계획이 있다는 사실을 부인했다. 재패니즈타임스는 루비오가 백악관 출마를 위해 직위를 떠나려는 계획도 없다고 부인했다고 보도했다.

sources.title: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses
